content:
# Export Shipping Documentation Process

Accurate export documentation is essential for customs clearance, banking compliance, and timely shipment of goods from India. Missing or incorrect papers can delay vessels, block remittances, and attract penalties.

Compliance World prepares and reviews your full export document set so shipments move smoothly from factory gate to overseas buyer.

## What We Handle

- Commercial invoice, packing list, and shipping bill coordination
- Letter of credit document alignment where applicable
- Customs and DGFT paperwork review before filing
- Bank and freight forwarder document handover support

## Why It Matters

Correct shipping documentation reduces detention risk, supports export incentive claims, and helps you receive foreign remittances without unnecessary queries from banks or customs.

Contact Compliance World to standardise your export documentation workflow.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Export Shipping Documentation Process.

What documents are typically required for export shipments?A commercial invoice, packing list, shipping bill, bill of lading or airway bill, and any product-specific certificates such as COO or inspection reports are commonly required.

Can Compliance World coordinate with my CHA and freight forwarder?Yes. We align documentation with your customs broker and logistics partner so filings stay consistent across parties.

# Bank AD Code Registration in Customs

An Authorised Dealer (AD) Code links your bank with customs systems so export proceeds and import payments can be processed correctly. Without a valid AD Code mapping, shipping bills and bills of entry can face processing issues.

Compliance World assists with Bank AD Code registration and customs portal mapping for smoother trade compliance.

## Scope of Service

- Guidance on bank AD Code issuance requirements
- Coordination for registration / mapping on ICEGATE or relevant customs systems
- Support for branch-level AD Code updates where needed
- Follow-up until the code is active for your IEC

## Who Needs This

Exporters and importers who have obtained an IEC and need their bank details recognised by Indian Customs for remittance and documentation processing.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Bank AD Code Registration in Customs.

Is AD Code different from IEC?Yes. IEC identifies your business for foreign trade. AD Code identifies the bank branch through which remittances are handled and must be registered with customs.

How long does AD Code registration take?Timelines vary by bank and customs processing. We prepare the application pack and follow up so activation is not delayed by incomplete details.

# Export Duty Refund Under Duty Paid

Where export duty has been paid and a refund is admissible under applicable customs or FTP provisions, a structured claim with supporting documents is required.

Compliance World helps evaluate eligibility, prepare documentation, and file export duty refund claims with the concerned authority.

## Our Support

- Eligibility review based on shipping and duty payment records
- Compilation of shipping bills, duty challans, and related proofs
- Drafting and filing of refund applications
- Follow-up on queries until disposal of the claim

## Outcome

A complete, audit-ready refund file that improves the chance of timely processing and reduces back-and-forth with customs.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Export Duty Refund Under Duty Paid.

When can export duty be refunded?Refunds depend on the specific notification, shipping status, and whether duty was paid in circumstances where a refund is allowed. We review your case before filing.

What records should I keep?Retain shipping bills, duty payment challans, bank payment proofs, and correspondence related to the shipment and claim.

# GST Refund - Inverted Duty / Zero-Rated Export

Exporters and businesses with inverted duty structures can claim GST refunds when input tax credit accumulates beyond output liability, or when zero-rated supplies are made under LUT or with payment of tax.

Compliance World prepares GST refund applications with reconciliations, statements, and portal filings aligned to current GST rules.

## Services Covered

- Zero-rated export refunds (with or without tax payment)
- Inverted duty structure refund computation and filing
- GSTR and shipping bill / invoice reconciliation support
- Response to GSTN deficiencies and follow-up

## Why Work With Us

Refund claims are frequently delayed by mismatched data. We focus on clean workings and document packs that stand up to scrutiny.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about GST Refund for Exports and Inverted Duty.

Do I need LUT for zero-rated export without tax?Yes, for exports without payment of IGST, a valid Letter of Undertaking (LUT) is generally required.

How often can refunds be filed?Refund frequency depends on your turnover, claim type, and GST portal rules for the relevant period. We advise the practical filing cycle for your case.

# Advance License

An Advance Authorisation (Advance License) allows duty-free import of inputs that are physically incorporated into an export product, subject to fulfilment of an export obligation.

Compliance World assists with Advance License applications, documentation, and obligation tracking under the Foreign Trade Policy.

## What We Assist With

- Product and input norm review
- Application preparation on the DGFT portal
- Supporting documents and undertaking filings
- Guidance on export obligation monitoring and redemption

## Ideal For

Manufacturers and merchant exporters who regularly import duty-bearing inputs for export production and want structured FTP compliance.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Advance License.

Is Advance License the same as EPCG?No. Advance License focuses on duty-free import of inputs for export products. EPCG focuses on capital goods with a linked export obligation.

Can Compliance World help after license issuance?Yes. We support shipment updates, obligation tracking, and redemption-related filings as needed.

# EPCG License

The Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG) scheme allows import of capital goods at zero or concessional duty, subject to an export obligation over a prescribed period.

Compliance World supports EPCG license applications, installation documentation, and obligation compliance planning.

## Coverage

- EPCG application drafting and DGFT filing
- Nexus justification for capital goods and export products
- Post-issuance installation and reporting guidance
- Export obligation monitoring support

## Benefit

Reduce upfront customs duty on eligible capital goods while staying compliant with FTP conditions.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about EPCG License.

Who can apply for EPCG?Manufacturer exporters and certain service providers meeting FTP eligibility can apply, subject to scheme conditions.

What happens if export obligation is not met?Non-fulfilment can attract duty recovery with interest and penalties. We help you plan and track obligations from the start.

# Issue BRC & FIRC Certificate

Bank Realisation Certificates (BRC) and Foreign Inward Remittance Certificates (FIRC) evidence receipt of export proceeds and are often required for incentives, GST refunds, and bank / DGFT compliance.

Compliance World coordinates with your bank and compiles the paperwork needed to obtain BRC / FIRC for your export transactions.

## How We Help

- Mapping remittances to shipping bills and invoices
- Bank liaison for e-BRC / FIRC issuance
- Correction support for mismatched remittance data
- Document set preparation for incentive or refund claims

## Why It Matters

Without proper realisation certificates, export benefit claims and certain compliance filings can be held up.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about BRC and FIRC.

What is the difference between BRC and FIRC?FIRC confirms receipt of foreign remittance. BRC / e-BRC specifically links realisation to export shipping bills for trade compliance.

Can you help if remittance was received in instalments?Yes. We help reconcile partial remittances against the relevant shipping documents.

# Export Under LC

Exporting under a Letter of Credit (LC) requires strict document compliance with LC terms. Even small discrepancies can lead to delayed payment or refusal by the negotiating / issuing bank.

Compliance World reviews LC terms and aligns your export documents so presentation stands a better chance of clean acceptance.

## Service Scope

- LC clause review for documentary risks
- Alignment of invoice, packing list, transport, and insurance documents
- Coordination tips for bank presentation
- Support on common discrepancy queries

## Who Benefits

Exporters shipping high-value consignments under documentary credit who want fewer bank queries and faster remittance.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Export Under LC.

Do you draft the LC itself?We primarily support exporters on document compliance against an issued LC. Where needed, we can flag risky clauses for discussion with your bank or buyer.

What causes most LC discrepancies?Mismatched descriptions, late presentation, incorrect transport documents, and inconsistent values or dates are common causes.

# COO Certificate

A Certificate of Origin (COO) certifies the country of origin of goods and is often required by overseas buyers, customs authorities, or preferential trade agreements.

Compliance World assists with ordinary and preferential COO applications through the relevant chambers, EPCs, or DGFT-authorised channels.

## Included Support

- Determination of ordinary vs preferential COO needs
- Application and document preparation
- Coordination with issuing authority
- Alignment with invoice and shipping details

## Result

A correctly issued COO that supports customs clearance and preferential duty claims in the destination market where applicable.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about COO Certificate.

Is COO mandatory for every export?Not always, but many buyers and destinations require it. Preferential COOs are needed when claiming FTA / PTA tariff benefits.

How long does issuance take?Timelines depend on the issuing body and completeness of documents. We prepare a clean pack to avoid avoidable delays.

# Issue IEC Certificate

An Importer Exporter Code (IEC) from DGFT is mandatory for most import and export transactions in India. It is a lifetime business identifier for foreign trade.

Compliance World handles IEC application, document verification, and DGFT portal filing so you can start cross-border trade with a valid certificate.

## What You Get

- Eligibility and document checklist
- Online DGFT application filing
- Follow-up until IEC generation
- Guidance on linking IEC with GST and bank AD Code where needed

## Next Steps After IEC

Once issued, we can also support ICEGATE registration, AD Code mapping, and related trade compliance setup.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Issue IEC Certificate.

Is IEC required for service exports?In many cases banks and FEMA-related reporting expect IEC for outward / inward trade remittances. We advise based on your transaction type.

Does IEC expire?IEC generally has lifetime validity, subject to DGFT updates and KYC / profile maintenance requirements.

# RoDTEP & Duty Drawback Refund

RoDTEP and Duty Drawback schemes refund embedded taxes / duties on exported products as per notified rates and conditions. Claims require accurate shipping data and portal compliance.

Compliance World helps compute, claim, and follow up RoDTEP and drawback benefits linked to your export shipments.

## Our Work Includes

- Scheme eligibility and rate mapping for your products
- Shipping bill and claim data review
- Portal claim support and discrepancy handling
- Coordination with customs / ICEGATE where required

## Benefit

Improve realisation of entitled export incentives with cleaner claim files and fewer processing objections.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about RoDTEP and Duty Drawback.

Can I claim both RoDTEP and drawback together?Availability depends on product, scheme conditions, and whether overlapping benefits are restricted. We check your product line before filing.

What if my shipping bill data is incorrect?Incorrect data can block claims. We help identify mismatches and guide corrective actions where the system allows.

# Checking Import Shipment Documentation

Import clearance depends on complete and consistent commercial, transport, and regulatory documents. Errors trigger queries, demurrage, and delayed delivery.

Compliance World reviews import document packs before arrival so your CHA and customs filing are based on correct information.

## Review Checklist

- Commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading / AWB
- Purchase order and LC terms consistency
- Product description, HSN, and valuation cues
- Licence / authorisation references where applicable

## Outcome

Fewer last-minute surprises at the port and a smoother handoff to customs clearance.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Checking Import Shipment Documentation.

When should documents be reviewed?Ideally before the vessel / flight arrives, so corrections can be requested from the supplier in time.

Do you handle restricted or licensed goods?Yes. We flag licence, NOC, or authorisation requirements early in the review.

# File Bill of Entry

A Bill of Entry is the key customs document for clearing imported goods into India. Accurate classification, valuation, and declaration are critical for lawful clearance.

Compliance World supports Bill of Entry preparation and coordination with your customs broker for timely filing on ICEGATE.

## Assistance Includes

- Document collation for BOE filing
- HSN / valuation readiness checks
- Coordination on provisional assessments where needed
- Post-filing query support

## Why Use Expert Support

Incorrect BOE filings can lead to reassessment, penalties, or clearance delays. We help keep declarations consistent with commercial documents.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about File Bill of Entry.

Who files the Bill of Entry?Filing is typically done through a CHA on ICEGATE. We prepare and review inputs so the filing is accurate.

Can BOE be amended after filing?Limited amendments may be possible depending on stage and customs rules. Early accuracy is always better.

# Custom Clearance

Customs clearance covers assessment, duty payment, examination, and out-of-charge for import or export consignments. Delays at this stage quickly turn into storage and demurrage costs.

Compliance World coordinates clearance workflows with documentation, duty computation support, and follow-up until goods are released.

## What We Cover

- Pre-clearance document readiness
- Duty and cess computation support
- Coordination with CHA / customs on queries
- Tracking until out-of-charge / LEO as applicable

## For Importers and Exporters

Whether you are bringing capital goods, raw materials, or finished products, structured clearance support reduces operational friction.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Custom Clearance.

Do you replace a CHA?We work alongside your CHA and internal team, focusing on documentation accuracy, compliance checks, and process follow-up.

How can clearance be sped up?Complete documents, correct classification, and early response to customs queries are the biggest time savers.

# Set Off Advance Transaction Against Import

Advance remittances for imports must be properly set off against actual import shipments for FEMA / bank and customs reconciliation. Incomplete set-off creates open advances and compliance risk.

Compliance World helps match advances to bills of entry and supports bank documentation for closure of advance import transactions.

## Support Areas

- Mapping advances to import invoices and BOEs
- Bank set-off paperwork coordination
- Follow-up on unmatched or partially utilised advances
- Record pack for audit and FEMA reporting needs

## Result

Cleaner bank and import ledgers with fewer open advance queries.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Set Off Advance Transaction Against Import.

Why is advance set-off important?Banks and FEMA frameworks expect advances to be linked to actual imports within permitted timelines.

What if goods arrive in multiple shipments?We help allocate the advance across shipments and close balances systematically.

# Shipment Follow-up to Delivery

Import logistics do not end at sailing confirmation. Tracking from shipment confirmation through customs, inland movement, and final delivery prevents cost overruns and stockouts.

Compliance World provides structured follow-up across carriers, CHA, and warehouse handoff until goods reach your premises.

## Follow-up Stages

- Shipment confirmation and ETA monitoring
- Arrival notice and document readiness checks
- Clearance status updates
- Last-mile delivery confirmation to your location

## Who This Helps

Businesses that want a single accountable thread from overseas dispatch to factory or warehouse receipt.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Shipment Follow-up to Delivery.

Is this the same as freight forwarding?No. We focus on compliance and status coordination. Freight booking can remain with your forwarder.

Can you cover multiple ports?Yes. We support consignments across major Indian ports and airports based on your lanes.

# Shipment Costing

Landed cost clarity is essential for pricing, margin control, and purchase decisions. Freight, insurance, duties, and local charges can significantly change the true cost of an import.

Compliance World prepares shipment costing sheets that consolidate commercial and logistics cost components for each consignment.

## Costing Components

- Product value, freight, and insurance
- Customs duty, GST, and other levies estimate
- Local charges and handling overlays where known
- Comparison views across shipments or suppliers

## Use Cases

Use costing outputs for vendor negotiation, pricing decisions, and management reporting.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about Shipment Costing.

Are duty estimates final?Estimates are based on available classification and value data. Final duty depends on customs assessment.

Can you cost exports as well?Yes. We can build export realisation and cost views including freight and incentive assumptions where relevant.

# EPCG & Advance License Update in Shipment

When imports or exports are made under EPCG or Advance Authorisation, shipping documents and licence balances must be updated correctly. Missed updates create obligation gaps and redemption issues later.

Compliance World helps update licence utilisation against shipments and keeps your authorisation records current.

## What We Update

- Licence reference on shipping documents / filings
- Quantity and value utilisation tracking
- Coordination for EDI / portal updates where required
- Alerts for approaching obligation shortfalls

## Why It Matters

Accurate shipment-level licence updates protect your duty benefits and simplify eventual redemption or EODC filings.

heading: Service
content:
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about EPCG and Advance License Update in Shipment.

When should licence updates be done?At the time of each relevant import or export shipment, not only at year-end.

Do you also handle licence redemption?Yes. Shipment updates feed into redemption and export obligation closure support.
